title: baphia longipedicellata subsp. keniensis
intro: Baphia longipedicellata subsp. keniensis, commonly known as the Kenyan Baphia, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, pain, and inflammation, due to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. These constituents contribute to the plant's potential in treating various health conditions, including microbial infections and oxidative stress.
